title: Receipt integrity check failed
description: The sealed receipt for this claim failed integrity verification. The digest or signature does not match the stored answer.
suggestion: Run 'velantrim verify-receipt <file>' for details. Do not promote this claim. Investigate the source of tampering.

context.note: This example illustrates RECEIPT_TAMPERED from the refusal reasons taxonomy. It is not the output of velantrim invariant-check — receipt integrity is SKIPPED_UNSUPPORTED at the invariant-check level. Use 'velantrim verify-receipt' to replay individual receipts.
